title: -  - Rahill - Gone Astray (Peanut Butter Wolf remix)

lines.l: No doubt about it, you've gone astray
Whose hand do you long for when you know?
I would take the high road but I don't stand a chance
Nothing ever comes easy when you're looking back
I stay asking you questions, you never reply
Just as the skies fall, the moon knows to rise.
Whose hand do you look for when you know?
California is where I sleep tonight
